fact: The World Bank mission of 9 to 13 December 2024 records that WURI-Niger enrolled over 3,000 people in a MOSIP-based registration pilot in September and October 2024 and that the government chose iris enrolment from age 5 and fingerprints for older people, with the identification system tender being prepared.
title: Programme d'Identification Unique pour l'Intégration Régionale et l'Inclusion en Afrique de l'Ouest (WURI, P169594), Mission d'appui à la mise en oeuvre, Aide-Mémoire
